--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB_SELECT_SRC
(
                ID,
                MERCHANT_ID,
                FEE_CODE,
                FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                FEE_TYPE,
                EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                FEE_CCY,
                FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                FEE_RATE,
                FEE_AMOUNT,
                FEE_STATUS,
                CHANNEL,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CREATED_DATE,
                CREATED_BY,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DATE,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                ID,
                MERCHANT_ID,
                FEE_CODE,
                FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                FEE_TYPE,
                EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                FEE_CCY,
                FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                FEE_RATE,
                FEE_AMOUNT,
                FEE_STATUS,
                CHANNEL,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CREATED_DATE,
                CREATED_BY,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DATE,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB_SELECT_SRC
(
                ID,
                MERCHANT_ID,
                FEE_CODE,
                FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                FEE_TYPE,
                EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                FEE_CCY,
                FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                FEE_RATE,
                FEE_AMOUNT,
                FEE_STATUS,
                CHANNEL,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CREATED_DATE,
                CREATED_BY,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DATE,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.ID,
                CC.MERCHANT_ID,
                CC.FEE_CODE,
                CC.FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                CC.TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                CC.FEE_TYPE,
                CC.EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                CC.FEE_CCY,
                CC.FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                CC.FEE_RATE,
                CC.FEE_AMOUNT,
                CC.FEE_STATUS,
                CC.CHANNEL,
                CC.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CC.CREATED_DATE,
                CC.CREATED_BY,
                CC.UPDATED_BY,
                CC.UPDATED_DATE,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB CC
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB_GROUP_SRC
(
                ID,
                MERCHANT_ID,
                FEE_CODE,
                FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                FEE_TYPE,
                EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                FEE_CCY,
                FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                FEE_RATE,
                FEE_AMOUNT,
                FEE_STATUS,
                CHANNEL,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CREATED_DATE,
                CREATED_BY,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DATE,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                ID,
                MERCHANT_ID,
                FEE_CODE,
                FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                FEE_TYPE,
                EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                FEE_CCY,
                FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                FEE_RATE,
                FEE_AMOUNT,
                FEE_STATUS,
                CHANNEL,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CREATED_DATE,
                CREATED_BY,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DATE,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                ID,
                MERCHANT_ID,
                FEE_CODE,
                FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                FEE_TYPE,
                EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                FEE_CCY,
                FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                FEE_RATE,
                FEE_AMOUNT,
                FEE_STATUS,
                CHANNEL,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CREATED_DATE,
                CREATED_BY,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DATE,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                ID,
                MERCHANT_ID,
                FEE_CODE,
                FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                FEE_TYPE,
                EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                FEE_CCY,
                FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                FEE_RATE,
                FEE_AMOUNT,
                FEE_STATUS,
                CHANNEL,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CREATED_DATE,
                CREATED_BY,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DATE
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB
(
                ID,
                MERCHANT_ID,
                FEE_CODE,
                FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                FEE_TYPE,
                EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                FEE_CCY,
                FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                FEE_RATE,
                FEE_AMOUNT,
                FEE_STATUS,
                CHANNEL,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                CREATED_DATE,
                CREATED_BY,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DATE,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.ID,
                SRC.MERCHANT_ID,
                SRC.FEE_CODE,
                SRC.FEE_DESCRIPTION,
                SRC.TRANSACTION_TYPE,
                SRC.FEE_TYPE,
                SRC.EFFECTIVE_DATE,
                SRC.FEE_CCY,
                SRC.FEE_CALCULATION_TYPE,
                SRC.FEE_RATE,
                SRC.FEE_AMOUNT,
                SRC.FEE_STATUS,
                SRC.CHANNEL,
                SRC.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT,
                SRC.CREATED_DATE,
                SRC.CREATED_BY,
                SRC.UPDATED_BY,
                SRC.UPDATED_DATE,
				SRC.FILE_DATE,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'MBK',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_MBK_FEEMANAGEMENTMTB_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT = 1
